skill.name: Distinguish Lab vs. Field CLS Measurement
skill.description: Identify whether Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) issues originate from load-time (measured by lab tools like Lighthouse) or post-load interactions (measured by field data in CrUX). Use this skill when CLS values differ significantly between lab-based and real-user measurements to route to the appropriate diagnostic approach.
skill.skill_body:
Compare CrUX field CLS score with Lighthouse lab CLS score. If CrUX reports substantially higher CLS than Lighthouse, the difference indicates post-load CLS. If scores are similar, CLS is primarily load-time. Document the disagreement magnitude and route to the corresponding diagnostic tool (DevTools Performance panel for load CLS; field data collection for post-load CLS).

## Objective

Classify CLS source (load-time vs. post-load) to enable targeted root-cause investigation
## Applicable Signals

- CrUX field CLS value higher than Lighthouse lab CLS value
- PageSpeed Insights shows discrepancy between 'Discover what your real users are experiencing' and 'Diagnose performance issues' sections
- Performance audit requires routing to appropriate diagnostic tool

## Contraindications

- Only lab-based measurement available; no field data collected
- CrUX data not accessible or unavailable for the URL
- Insufficient time window for field data collection

## Intervention Moves

- Route to DevTools Performance panel Layout Shifts track for load-time CLS investigation
- Route to field data collection or live metrics view for post-load CLS investigation

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Retrieve CrUX CLS score', 'detail': "Access PageSpeed Insights 'Discover what your real users are experiencing' section or CrUX dataset for the target URL"}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Retrieve Lighthouse lab CLS score', 'detail': "Access PageSpeed Insights 'Diagnose performance issues' section or run Lighthouse audit locally"}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Compare scores', 'detail': 'Calculate the difference between CrUX and Lighthouse CLS values'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Classify source', 'detail': 'If CrUX >> Lighthouse, classify as post-load CLS; if similar, classify as load-time CLS'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Route to diagnostic tool', 'detail': 'For load CLS: use DevTools Performance panel Layout Shifts track. For post-load CLS: collect field data or use live metrics view'}

## Constraints

- Requires access to both CrUX data and Lighthouse results for the same URL
- Field data must represent sufficient user interactions to be statistically meaningful
- Comparison is most reliable when both measurements cover similar time periods

## Cautions

- Disagreement between CrUX and Lighthouse does not automatically indicate post-load CLS; other factors may contribute
- Field data collection requires instrumentation; cannot be performed retroactively without prior setup

## Output Contract

- Clear determination of CLS source (load-time or post-load) with magnitude of disagreement; explicit routing recommendation to DevTools Performance panel (for load CLS) or field data collection (for post-load CLS)

## Example Therapist Responses

### Example 1

- Client/Input: PageSpeed Insights shows CrUX CLS of 0.25 and Lighthouse CLS of 0.08
- Therapist/Output: Post-load CLS confirmed (0.17 point difference). Route to: collect field data using Performance panel live metrics view to identify user interactions causing shifts.
- Notes: Large disagreement indicates substantial post-load layout shifts

### Example 2

- Client/Input: PageSpeed Insights shows CrUX CLS of 0.10 and Lighthouse CLS of 0.09
- Therapist/Output: Load-time CLS primary concern (0.01 point difference). Route to: DevTools Performance panel Layout Shifts track to identify elements shifting during initial load.
- Notes: Minimal disagreement suggests CLS is mostly load-time
